# Pulumi license

`LICENSE` is a verbatim copy of Pulumi's license file, vendored 2026-07-27
from https://github.com/pulumi/pulumi/blob/master/LICENSE. It is the standard
Apache License 2.0 text; Pulumi's repository ships it without a filled-in
copyright line, which is why nothing in the file itself names Pulumi.

Pulumi is copyright Pulumi Corporation and contributors. This copy covers the
Pulumi-derived material in state-db — compatibility tooling, recorded protocol
fixtures, and API snapshots; see NOTICE. bin/generate-third-party-notices also
embeds it in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt as the Apache-2.0 appendix.
